name: SuQing's Portals
description: 0.1.3 Lua test candidate. Build, name and pair four-facing portals in single-player. Four dedicated slots preserve original car batteries in a native internal item container; install and remove them through the portal management window. Trip energy is configurable from 0.5 to 4 full-battery equivalents, default 2, paid entirely at departure; arrival needs neither batteries nor power. Charging occurs only while the gate is loaded and locally powered, at a default total rate of 0.5 equivalents per game hour. Includes a dedicated status window and optional Viewpoint models. Portal functionality uses Lua with no added portal Java module. Nonempty old Java-test battery data remains preserved with a safe-export notice. Offline checks do not replace user gameplay acceptance. Vehicle, trailer and multiplayer transport are not included. Each new gate requires eight small metal sheets, four pipes, eight wires, sixteen electronics scraps, one premium camera and one handheld walkie-talkie, with Electrical 4 and Welding 3; a screwdriver, blowtorch and welding mask are retained without additional torch fuel use. Management is resizable with a compact four-slot layout and prominent power, identifiable supply sources and charging status. The item-giver feature and its sandbox switch have been removed.
